main_text.p: Tonici sunt 15. quorum 14 notantur supra vocem; 11. infra.
main_text.head: Supra vocem.
Infra vocem.
main_text.p: De hifce notentur istæ regulæ. Pafchta & Kadma eandem figuram habent, at ille initio vel medio vocis inhæret, hic fini tantum, nisi in eadem voce geminetur.
Jethif initio ante primam vocalem ponitur.
Mahpach extremæ vel mediæ literæ adhæret.
Rebbiah mediæ literæ incumbit: Sic differt à Cholem, quod ad latus.

page.notes: The Hebrew trope signs before each name are not reliably readable at this scan resolution, so each is marked illegible. The right edge of the page is clipped by the scan, so the right ends of some lines may be cut off. Printed spelling is kept as it appears, including "hifce" and "Rebbiah" (printed "Rebhiah" in the running text).
